wasted_steps.effect: The roots drawer was already open; the tap hit its title area and produced no semantic change.
The visible storage row did not require scrolling; the swipe produced no semantic change.
The same unnecessary drawer scroll repeated and produced no semantic change.
The model again targeted the title/menu area instead of the visible storage row.

root_cause.summary: After the destination roots drawer opened, the controller exposed neither its active state nor whether a proposed tap hit a visible drawer row, so repeated title taps and unnecessary swipes consumed the remaining budget.
details: r31 correctly prevented the prior invalid-after-repair failure and retained a protocol-valid episode.
The roots drawer visibly contained the storage row needed to continue; no scrolling or second menu tap was necessary.
The screenshot-local semantic hash did not distinguish the open drawer reliably, and the later loop Critic could diagnose no progress but could not bind the repair to a visible drawer row.
Increasing the 20-step budget would hide this control-selection defect and is therefore not authorized.

r32_required_change.scope: Navigation while the Android Files roots drawer is visibly open.
mechanism: Detect the open roots drawer from visible standard root/category rows and their enabled accessibility bounds.
When a usable storage/category row is visible, reject wait, swipe, and taps that do not hit a visible enabled drawer row.
Constrain the one bounded repair to a tap that hits a visible enabled drawer row chosen from the task and current screen.
Do not inject a row coordinate or select the target on behalf of the model.
Preserve the existing destination commit critic and r31 empty-directory semantics.
prohibited: Changing the model, seed, tasks, evaluator, schedule, or acceptance thresholds
